name: Invoice
description: An invoice — a sales form recording a sale to a customer on credit (amounts owed).

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: System-assigned unique identifier for the Invoice. Required to reference the object on get and update.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Used for optimistic concurrency; must be supplied on update and must match the latest stored value.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive metadata about the entity, maintained by the system.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated (read-only).

fields.name: CustomerRef
fields.description: Reference to the customer associated with this invoice. Required for create.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Individual line items of the transaction. At least one sales line (SalesItemLineDetail or GroupLineDetail) is required for create.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Id of the line item. Read-only on response; supply the existing Id to retain a line during a sparse update.

attributes.name: LineNum
attributes.description: Position of the line in the collection of transaction lines.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the line item.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: Total amount of the line item. Required for most detail types.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating which detail object is populated for this line.

attributes.name: ClassRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Class for this line.

attributes.name: UnitPrice
attributes.description: Unit price of the item. Mutually exclusive with PriceLevelRef.

attributes.name: MarkupInfo
attributes.description: Markup information for billable expenses charged on this line.

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: True if the markup is computed as a percentage.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.description: Markup value, as a percentage when PercentBased is true.

attributes.name: MarkUpIncomeAccountRef
attributes.description: Income account used to track the markup.

attributes.name: ItemAccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the income account associated with the item.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Sales tax code for this line item (e.g. TAX/NON or a tax code Id).

attributes.name: ServiceDate
attributes.description: Date when the service is performed.

attributes.name: TaxInclusiveAmt
attributes.description: The total amount of the line item including tax.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced group Item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced group Item.

attributes.name: Line
attributes.description: Individual sales lines comprising the group.

attributes.name: ServiceDate
attributes.description: Date when the service is performed.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for this description line.

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: True if the discount is a percentage; false if a fixed amount.

attributes.name: DiscountPercent
attributes.description: Percentage by which the amount due is reduced, 0-100. Valid when PercentBased is true.

attributes.name: DiscountAccountRef
attributes.description: Income account used to track the discount.

attributes.name: ClassRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Class for the discount.

attributes.name: SubTotalLineDetail
attributes.description: Populated when DetailType is SubTotalLineDetail. Represents a subtotal of preceding lines.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: Date when the transaction occurred. Defaults to the current date if not supplied.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction (invoice number). Auto-assigned if custom transaction numbers are enabled and this is omitted.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User-entered, private memo not visible to the customer. Max 4000 characters.

fields.name: CustomerMemo
fields.description: Message to the customer that appears in the printed/emailed invoice.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The message text shown to the customer.

fields.name: DueDate
fields.description: Date when the payment is due. Computed from SalesTermRef if not provided.

fields.name: BillAddr
fields.description: Billing address for the invoice.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: System-assigned Id of the address object.

attributes.name: Lat
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geocoded address.

attributes.name: Long
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geocoded address.

fields.name: ShipAddr
fields.description: Shipping address for the invoice.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: System-assigned Id of the address object.

attributes.name: Lat
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geocoded address.

attributes.name: Long
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geocoded address.

fields.name: FreeFormAddress
fields.description: If true, the address is stored as free-form text rather than structured components.

fields.name: ShipFromAddr
fields.description: Origin address from which goods are shipped (structured like BillAddr/ShipAddr).

fields.name: ClassRef
fields.description: Reference to the Class associated with the entire transaction.

fields.name: SalesTermRef
fields.description: Reference to the sales term (payment terms) associated with the transaction.

fields.name: Deposit
fields.description: Amount already deposited/paid at the time the invoice was created; reduces the open balance.

fields.name: ShipMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to the shipping method for the invoice.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Id of the referenced shipping method.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced shipping method.

fields.name: ShipDate
fields.description: Date for delivery of goods or services.

fields.name: TrackingNum
fields.description: Shipping provider's tracking number for the delivery.

fields.name: CustomField
fields.description: Custom fields configured on transactions in the company.

attributes.name: DefinitionId
attributes.description: Id of the custom field definition.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: Data type of the custom field.

attributes.name: StringValue
attributes.description: Value of the custom field when Type is StringType.

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Sales tax information for the transaction as a whole.

attributes.name: TotalTax
attributes.description: Total tax calculated for the transaction, excluding tax lines manually inserted into the line list.

attributes.name: TaxLine
attributes.description: Tax detail lines describing how the total tax was computed.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: Tax amount for this tax line.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator for the tax line detail.

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: True if the tax is computed as a percentage.

attributes.name: NetAmountTaxable
attributes.description: Net amount on which the tax is calculated.

fields.name: ApplyTaxAfterDiscount
fields.description: If true, sales tax is calculated after a discount is applied to the subtotal.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method by which tax is applied (non-US locales). Applicable when automated sales tax is not used.

fields.name: PrintStatus
fields.description: Printing status of the invoice.

fields.name: EmailStatus
fields.description: Email status of the invoice.

fields.name: BillEmail
fields.description: Primary email address to which the invoice is sent.

fields.name: BillEmailCc
fields.description: Carbon-copy email address for the invoice (requires the cc feature).

fields.name: BillEmailBcc
fields.description: Blind carbon-copy email address for the invoice (requires the bcc feature).

fields.name: DeliveryInfo
fields.description: Email delivery information, populated by the system after the invoice is emailed.

attributes.name: DeliveryType
attributes.description: How the invoice was delivered (e.g. Email).

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency of all amounts on the transaction. Required if multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: Currency exchange rate from the transaction currency to the home currency. Valid only when multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: ProjectRef
fields.description: Reference to the Project this invoice is associated with (Projects feature).

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: Reference to the recurring transaction template from which this invoice was generated (read-only).

fields.name: TaxExemptionRef
fields.description: Reference to the tax exemption for automated sales tax (read-only).

fields.name: LinkedTxn
fields.description: Transactions linked to this invoice (e.g. estimates, payments, time charges).

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: Type of the linked transaction (e.g. Estimate, Payment, StatementCharge, ReimburseCharge).

attributes.name: TxnLineId
attributes.description: Line item Id of the linked transaction, when linking to a specific line.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction in the transaction currency, including tax. Calculated by the system.

fields.name: HomeTotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction in the home currency. Populated when multicurrency is enabled (read-only).

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: Unpaid amount still owed on the invoice, in the transaction currency (read-only).

fields.name: HomeBalance
fields.description: Unpaid balance of the invoice expressed in the home currency. Populated when multicurrency is enabled (read-only).

fields.name: AllowOnlineCreditCardPayment
fields.description: If true, the customer may pay this invoice online by credit card (QuickBooks Payments).

fields.name: AllowOnlineACHPayment
fields.description: If true, the customer may pay this invoice online by bank transfer/ACH (QuickBooks Payments).

fields.name: AllowIPNPayment
fields.description: If true, online payment via Intuit Payment Network is enabled (read-only).

fields.name: InvoiceLink
fields.description: Sharable link to the online invoice. Returned only when the request includes the include=invoiceLink query parameter (read-only).

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Internal field indicating the originating domain. Always 'QBO' (read-only).

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: Indicates whether the response is a sparse (partial) representation of the object.

specialOperations.name: Void an invoice
specialOperations.description: Voids an existing invoice; the transaction remains active but all amounts and quantities are zeroed and the string 'Voided' is injected into Invoice.PrivateNote, prepended to existing text if present.

queryParams.name: operation
queryParams.description: Must be set to 'void' to void the invoice. Request body must include a minimum of Invoice.Id and the current Invoice.SyncToken.

specialOperations.note: POST to the base invoice endpoint with operation=void query param; body needs Id and SyncToken.

specialOperations.name: Get an invoice as PDF
specialOperations.description: Returns the specified invoice as an Adobe Portable Document Format (PDF) file, formatted according to the company's custom form styles.

pathParams.name: invoiceId
pathParams.description: The Id of the invoice to retrieve as PDF.

specialOperations.note: Response Content-Type is application/pdf (binary PDF), not JSON.

specialOperations.name: Send an invoice
specialOperations.description: Emails the specified invoice to the recipient; sets Invoice.EmailStatus to EmailSent and populates Invoice.DeliveryInfo with sending information.

queryParams.name: sendTo
queryParams.description: Explicit email address to send the invoice to. If specified, Invoice.BillEmail.Address is updated to this value. If omitted, the email is sent to the address supplied in Invoice.BillEmail.EmailAddress.

pathParams.name: invoiceId
pathParams.description: The Id of the invoice to send.

specialOperations.note: Two variants: implicit (uses email in Invoice.BillEmail.EmailAddress, no query param) vs explicit (sendTo=<emailAddr> query param overrides BillEmail.Address).
